On The Rocks

Fully-charged vocals, pedal-to-the-metal showmanship, stellar musicianship & fantastic hair.

About On The Rocks

On The Rocks is a high-energy rock and indie band bringing electric vibes to weddings and parties across the UK and beyond. Available as a 3 or 4-piece lineup, their full setup includes vocals/guitar, bass, drums, and lead guitar, with rich backing vocals throughout. Fronted by Aussie rocker Jeremy , who once opened for Bon Jovi , and backed by Ewan, Simone, and Sebastian, their chemistry on stage is tight, fun, and infectious. With 240+ songs across rock, indie, and pop, their setlist spans The Killers , Guns N’ Roses , Coldplay , and beyond. Whether you’re after big singalongs or floor-filling anthems, they’ve got it covered. All members are pro musicians with impressive CVs—from Isle of Wight Festival to O2 Academy —and they’re proud to deliver a seamless, friendly, and professional experience. On The Rocks also offers a customisable setlist, playlist music, and a band member DJ, plus a dedicated manager to ensure every detail is sorted before the big day.
